description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). 2026-07-18 (PR #494 marketplace + preset removal + review polish): vs the pre-marketplace baseline, duplicatedLines 956->958 (+2) and complexFunctions 242->243 (+1) from the new src/features/marketplace/ browse/fetch/install substrate — net of a -1 complexity reduction from the review-polish pass (dead-code removal + a shared agentRosterId helper). criticalComplexity is CRAP-based: measure with no coverage/ artifacts present (as CI's quality job does) or it inflates. Deliberate, reviewed trade-off.
